purpose: Prevent a single analyst output or provider-specific consensus definition from being treated as a definition-free analyst view or valuation primitive.
semantics: EPS revision is earnings-expectation change, not a complete bullish/bearish analyst-view proxy.
Cross-output disagreement is preserved as MULTI_OUTPUT_DIVERGENCE rather than averaged into one directional score.
UNCHANGED_EPS does not imply NO_NEW_INFORMATION when another output changed.
Target price is an independently evaluated forecast output with bias, accuracy and freshness diagnostics.
providerInvariance: Vendor-produced Forward PE is a derived value, not a canonical primitive.
Reconstruct valuation from PIT price, PIT forecast population, fiscal horizon, forecast basis and provider-eligibility provenance.
If an apparent effect disappears under a second valid provider definition or fixed-membership reconstruction, mark PROVIDER_DEFINITION_FRAGILE.
Do not select a provider, stale cutoff, aggregation rule or output combination by realized return.
diagnostics: within-forecaster cross-output direction matrix at matched publication event
incremental information of target-price/recommendation/revenue revisions after EPS revision and existing System factors
provider-population/eligibility decomposition before any return join
falsification: If added outputs have no stable incremental value after controls, mark REDUNDANT.
If direction flips across horizons, providers or reasonable eligibility definitions, do not collapse to one score.
If timestamps, identity, lineage or provider policy provenance are insufficient, fail closed to UNKNOWN.
Do not treat multi-output consistency as automatically higher quality; published evidence is mixed after confound controls.
taiwanContext: Taiwan target-price studies report material optimism/overshooting and time-decaying accuracy, while also finding information content versus simple historical alternatives; therefore target price is neither discarded nor trusted directionally without prospective validation.
